note: Oak-hickory hills on the Barry-McDonald county line with a spring, a shooting range and multi-use (hiking, biking, horse) trails. The map marks four primitive camping spots: the most used is in open woods beside the gravel road north of County Road 2230 near the east side, where trailers park among the trees; the other three are roadside spots on the MDC road through the west half, this pin among them, with no cleared pad. --Claude

flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites; Individual Campsites'; also 'Trails: Biking, Horseback, Hiking' and a shooting range. Brochure (08/2022): 'Primitive camping is permitted in spots designated on the area map. Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period. Groups of more than 10 campers need a special-use permit.' 'Motor vehicles are allowed on public roadways and in parking areas. ATV use is prohibited.' The map (Last Updated 3/1/2022) legend has Primitive Camping; four symbols, matching GIS points 1-4 (Type 'Primitive Camping Area'). No horse camp is labelled anywhere: the legend's only horse item is the 'Hiking/Biking/Equestrian Trail' line, so there is no horse camp to tell apart.

CAMPS on imagery (leaf-off, ~0.25 m/px): GIS 1 (36.60588,-94.04593, east, on the gravel road running north from County Road 2230, gravel lot 8242 ~90 m SE) = open oak woods beside the road with two travel trailers and tow vehicles parked 40-60 m NW of the point - the camp in use. GIS 2 (the pin) = a spot 5 m off an unpaved dirt road in woods, no cleared pad or pull-off visible, nearest lot 613 362 m NE. GIS 3 (36.60827,-94.06750, 1.0 km S of the pin) and GIS 4 (36.63193,-94.06879, 1.6 km N) = points in woods beside the MDC road, no pad visible. Padless roadside camping that MDC designates stays; the note carries the caveat. A 23-ft rig fits at GIS 1 (trailers of similar size are there); at 2-4 only by pulling off the road where the woods allow. No ford/4WD/rig wording.

PIN (main camp): stored 36.61757,-94.06595 = GIS 2, a minor padless spot. Move to the main camp at GIS 1, onto the open ground where the trailers park: 36.6065,-94.0461 (point 1 itself is 60 m S in the trees).

CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT proposed: GIS 1 is 2.2 km E of the pin on a different gravel road off County Road 2230; GIS 2-4 all sit on the one MDC road through the west half (2-3 1.0 km apart, 2-4 1.6 km). With the pin moved to GIS 1, the west spots are minor padless roadside spots. If AWH wants them listed, the candidate is one split 'Flag Spring Conservation Area (west road camps)' at GIS 2 36.61757,-94.06595; nothing else in campgrounds.json lies within 3 km.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): brochure 'There are no fishing opportunities on this area'; the spring is on the west side; no water near any camp.
